3845-4279-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3845-4279-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

277-1021-4693-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

1981-2324-2415-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-5700-5701-6763-7889.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6763-7889.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

121-553-7468.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Hypersonic Dragon.
In response, cast Swat Away by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

943-2203-2597-3147-4235.easyPrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Guildless Commons.
943-2203-2597-3147-4235.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding two mana.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding two additional mana.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Azorius Chancery.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Azorius Chancery.
Repeat.

3558-3661-4668-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

4050-6972-7640.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reputable Merchant.
When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2724-3217-7068.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Baboon Spirit. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1308-1558-3478-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1308-1558-3478-3875-4231.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1824-2530-6710-7359.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-6710-7359.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Tablet of the Guilds triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

252-913-2440-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it. It will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
When the Improvised Arsenal token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Dinosaur you control.
If needed, activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
252-913-2440-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more Dinosaurs as the combo begins. You should perform step 3 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool.

240-4050-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4556-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4050-4556-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Blight Mound and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

628-2921-7219.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

677-3430-6974.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} if Ashling Command is in your hand, or {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} if it's in your graveyard, plus an additional {4} in colored mana that is at least three different colors
677-3430-6974.description:
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating two Treasure tokens and choosing any other mode.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding three mana in each of two different colors.
Repeat.
677-3430-6974.notes: You can make tokens of Nyxbloom Ancient using Ashling's Command to make more mana each iteration, but the combo can sustain itself with just one Nyxbloom Ancient.

2533-4681-5231-6913.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5497-5998-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Repeat.

4038-5821-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Fyndhorn Elder's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

1805-4331-4993-7010.description:

Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1486-5433-5929--119.easyPrerequisites: You control an untapped creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1486-5433-5929--119.description:
Tap a creature using any method.
Magda triggers, as the creature is a Dwarf due to Leyline of Transformation, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token and giving it haste until end of turn.
Repeat, tapping the Goblin instead.
1486-5433-5929--119.notes: The method used to tap creatures must be usable for all creatures you control for the loop to continue. You may use Krenko (or Magda if it doesn't have summoning sickness) to start the combo if they're untapped. Some methods may overt the summoning sickness requirement (like Earthcraft, for example).

339-677-2511-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-6797-6965.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1462-1537-2034-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts.
When the Zealous Conscripts token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zealous Conscripts token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

692-5630-6687-6688.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create an artifact token.
692-5630-6687-6688.description:
Create an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor and Sarinth Steelseeker trigger.
Resolve the Wildwood Mentor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sarinth Steelseeker trigger, revealing Moss-Pit Skeleton from the top of your library and putting it into your graveyard.
Unshakable Tail triggers, creating a Clue token.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-5968-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
2921-5968-5972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.

1170-3821-6057.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{W}.
1170-3821-6057.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{W}.
Cast Cage of Hands by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cage of Hands spell.
Activate Cage of Hands by paying {1}{W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

144-413-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-413-5434.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
When Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield face-down, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Blasting Station and Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Ashcloud Phoenix trigger, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

565-2743-2871.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, targeting Biovisionary.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving Biovisionary +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat two additional times, foregoing paying the buyback cost on the final iteration.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1102-1379-1636-3197.notablePrerequisites: Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
1102-1379-1636-3197.description:
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-2478-3338.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Mishra's Bauble.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by sacrificing it.
Repeat.
